chapter_focus: Diversity in the Living World — biodiversity, classification of plants and animals, adaptations.
intro: Curated extras for chapter 2. Admin should confirm that each link is live and content is suitable for Class 6 before approving for the public catalog.

items.title: DIKSHA — Class 6 Science Chapter 2
items.summary: Government of India's official online learning portal. Search for 'Class 6 Science Diversity Living World' to find textbook-aligned video lessons and worksheets.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: Confirm chapter content under the 2024 'Curiosity' textbook syllabus.

items.title: Wildlife Institute of India — Biodiversity Resources
items.summary: The WII publishes accessible articles on Indian biodiversity, animal classification, and conservation efforts. Great background reading for teachers.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: pick a single article suitable for class introduction.

items.title: iNaturalist — Identify Plants and Animals
items.summary: A free crowdsourced species-identification tool. Students can upload photos of plants or animals from their school garden walk and the community helps identify them.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: needs internet on student devices; alternatively, the teacher can use a single class account.

items.title: BBC Earth — Wildlife videos for children
items.summary: High-quality videos showing animal adaptations to land, water, and air. Useful as a 5-minute hook for the lesson.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: pick a specific clip and ensure it loads from your network.

items.title: NCERT Pathshala — Bio-resources
items.summary: Supplementary booklets and posters from NCERT covering plant and animal classification at a beginner's level. Good for a printable wall chart.
items.note_for_teacher: Admin: download and check the latest revision matches the 'Curiosity' syllabus.
